title: Utility of 6-aza-2-thiothymine in the synthesis of novel [1,2,4]triazolo[4,3-b][1,2,4]triazin-7-one derivatives: synthesis, structure elucidation, molecular docking and in vitro anti-lung cancer activity
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,6015-6031
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08958H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Monica G. Kamel, Farid M. Sroor, Khaled Mahmoud, Heba I. Shafey, Hamdi M. Hassaneen, Laure Vendier
Novel triazolo[4,3-b][1,2,4]triazin-7-one derivatives (7a–j) were synthesized and tested against PC3, A549, PACA2 and BJ1 cell lines. 7a and 7g were investigated using DNA fragmentation, DNA damage and gene expression and molecular docking studies.
